notes: 750 mm and 970 mm overall base widths are preferred sizes according to source.
Section modulus header mm3 x 10^6; no published Ixx column for Solid Box.

Nominal drawing polygon for width classes (2) and (3) reproduces all published areas exactly. Class (1) area rounds to nearest 10 mm2 with a +5 mm2 difference. Class (4) published areas differ by +225 mm2 for SD1-SD5 and +275 mm2 for SD6-SD8; do not modify geometry silently to match.
blockers: Resolve width class (4) area/centroid/modulus discrepancy with producer or original dimensioned drawings before implementing that width.

evidence.method: Property/dimension table p30 checked against rendered page; Appendix C reinforcement outlines inspected for missing profile information.

notes: W1/W2/W3 in column headings are drawing dimension symbols; they are not girder designations.
Web is a vertical dimension of the sloping inner web segment, not thickness.
V is absent for W1-W15; null retains the source dash rather than treating it as a measured zero.
Appendix C strand pitches, reinforcement offsets and strand elevations are not concrete-profile dimensions.
Drawings show two outline regimes: W1-W15 and W16-W19.
blockers: Published drawings do not explicitly dimension all inner bottom-slab vertices, corner radii or lower corner vertical extent. Do not derive these from drawing scale or strand coordinates. Obtain mould/CAD profile or additional authoritative dimensioned drawing before geometry implementation.
